## Compatible consumer source-binding extension

Binding identity: `PTC-UNIFORM-CONSUMER-COMPOSITION r0.4/2026-09-06`.
This is a new immutable binding generation for composition, not a new
scientific predicate. In this paired Registry revision only,
`SCI-MAP:map_upstream_admission@2` and `SCI-JINC:jinc_map_contribution@1`
may bind the corresponding exact uniform successor above instead of the
predecessor's unselected coefficient slot. All other inherited source bindings
and the complete consumer policy records remain exact. Their scientific
rules already require a separately selected, permitted, realized PTC family
and independent QC. The approved successor fills that slot and changes no
consumer predicate, exception, role, truth rule, action or lifecycle. Evaluation
identity must include this new Registry/register revision and boundary digest;
the bare inherited profile key cannot silently substitute the new binding.
Other coefficient families, previous evaluations and unrelated profiles keep
their original bindings. No MAP/JINC admission follows merely from PTC QC.

SCI-NOI records remain inherited exactly: no r0.5 successor profile is admitted,
and no existing NOI source binding is rewritten or extended by this record.
The complete MAP-parent rational-source requirement remains an additional
NOI gate. A coefficient equal to rational 1/1 does not satisfy it alone.
Any change to the source or compatibility conditions requires a new immutable
paired Registry/register revision and explicit affected-profile binding.
